newsitem.title: USA: IEC sees Q3 EPS between $0.20 and $0.24.
newsitem.headline: IEC sees Q3 EPS between $0.20 and $0.24.

text.p: IEC Electronics said Tuesday it expects earnings for the third fiscal quarter ended June 27 to range between $0.20 and $0.24 per share on revenues of between $60 and $62 million.
The company said its sales and earnings will be in line with prior estimates.
Analysts' consensus estimate for the quarter was $0.22, according to First Call.
Revenues during the third quarter of the last fiscal year were $43.4 million, with a net loss of $0.25 per share.
The company said it has had three good quarters and a record backlog that suggests it could set a new sales record with earnings in excess of last year's.
